**Summary: Operations WFH policy change (effective Tue 3 Nov 2026)**

- **Main change:** Operations staff must be in the office at least 3 days a week (up from 2). Team leaders will set one common team day weekly.
- **Exceptions:** Formal flexible work arrangements (approved under Fair Work) stay unchanged until their next review. Informal manager agreements don't count. Claims Lodgement and Customer Contact teams are excluded; their rosters will be reviewed in early 2027.
- **Equipment:** Existing equipment stays, but new home office equipment won't be funded unless a workplace health assessment recommends it.
- **Hot desking:** Levels 3 and 4 move to booked desks (via Spaces app, up to two weeks ahead), with lockers provided.
- **Rationale:** Newer staff feel they miss learning from experienced colleagues, and the company wants better use of paid-for office space.
- **Questions:** Go to managers first; a Q&A is on the intranet.
